claim_one_line: The door made a link and the two blind gates repaired. THE DOOR: Q(sqrt-3) has discriminant -3 so 3 is its unique ramified prime with (3) = (sqrt-3)^2 and residue field F_3; SL(2, O/(sqrt-3)) = SL(2,3) = 2T; pi_1(m004) surjects onto 2T in exactly two classes up to automorphism; and the McKay graph of 2T at its faithful two-dimensional representation IS the affine E6 diagram (7 nodes, 6 edges, marks 1,1,1,2,2,2,3) -- with both controls firing, since the same construction on Q8 returns affine D4 and there is no surjection onto SL(2,5) = 2I, so the door does not open onto E8. Minted as chain link C57 after fifteen months as prose, with its genericity scope travelling with it; the chain is now 57 links, 53 forced, 36 theorems. THE GATES: the retraction sweep now reads every tracked .py as well as .md and .tex -- the hole the E82 retraction hid in, where two tests PASSED while asserting it and were listed as locks for the row that corrects it -- made ten times faster by a whole-file reject pass, taught to recognise past-tense refutations, and it immediately caught a test file whose docstring was the draft headline its own test refutes; and harvest_debt now computes its SCHEDULED count from the ledger rather than from live remotes, with a growth ratchet, so retiring a seat can no longer retire its debt (L224 closed the day it was registered).
